name: hasa-2-bot
description: WhatsApp MD bot with pairing-code login and modular plugins

scripts.check: node --check index.js && for f in lib/*.js plugins/*.js legacy-plugins/*.cjs; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done && for f in plugins/*.js; do node --input-type=module -e "await import('./$f')" || exit 1; done && node --input-type=module -e "await import('./lib/subbot-manager.js')" && node -e "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('config.example.json','utf8'))"
